description: Explicit mapping from the WS1 supply-chain CSV (data/synthetic_data.csv) to the canonical company history schema (DATA_SCHEMAS.md section 2). Reviewed by: nobody yet (WS1 + WS4 review required).

currency.fx_note: ILLUSTRATIVE fixed rate chosen for the demonstration, not market data. Applied to every EUR money column and every month. Replace with a sourced rate (and date) before any non-synthetic use.

operating_profit_gbp.note: EBITDA is used as the operating-profit series; the CSV reports no depreciation, so it is not EBIT.

not_reported.employees: Not in the CSV. Stored as 0; no calculation reads it.
not_reported.gas_kwh: Not in the CSV. Stored as 0: the action assumptions allocate no scope1 to gas (gas_share = 0), so no gas emissions are implied or removed.
not_reported.business_travel_km: Not in the CSV. Stored as 0: travel_share = 0, so the travel action has no eligible opportunity and zero cost.
not_reported.cloud_compute_hours: Not in the CSV. Stored as 0: cloud_share = 0, so the cloud action has no eligible opportunity and zero cost.
